400.description: Unknown schema version, or a mutation was refused; nothing was written

409.description: The state changed while this edit was being applied

AdmitRequest.description: Omission is refused for UniverseTarget; an explicit JSON null is a value.

AdvisoryCandidateResponse.description:
Explicitly identifies the review-only candidate-state surface. Candidate
rows are never presented as canonical admitted objects.

force.description: Explicit immediate reconsideration, for precondition_review only.

limit.description: Non-interview producers: how many Tasks to select.

task_id.description: `clarify` only: the Task to interview. Omitted, the first Task with no description.

round.description:
The interview round a Clarify run asked for: one more than the rounds the
operator has answered. Absent for SuggestTags and when no Task was selected.
`clarify_no_questions` on round 1 and on a later round mean different things.

AnswerRequest.description: The operator's answers, by question id. Answering is what admits a clarification proposal.

moved.description: Successful Static window edits, included in updated.

resized.description: Successful Dynamic duration edits, included in updated.

updated.description: Tasks whose canonical state actually changed.

CalendarExportMode.description: Live requires operator configuration and explicit in-memory enablement.

static_anchor.description:
Whether the event's Task is Static: placed at a window of its own, and
not packed by the planner. Read from the Plan step, or from the Task
record when the Plan no longer holds it. **Never inferred from the
colour**: a Static Task with no category has no colour, and a colour
on a Dynamic event means done.

CalendarProjectionPreviewResponse.description:
Persisted preview of the current Calendar, diffed against the last applied
event set. Preview changes projection records only; it makes no client calls.

matching_placements.description: Current Dynamic Plan placements matching the applied snapshot; excludes Static commitments and retained completed history.

completed_seconds.description: Dynamic Tasks completed inside the range, by observed window or estimate.

static_seconds.description: Overlap of Static windows with the range, whether or not the Task was completed.

task_count.description: Tasks that contributed to this row.

n_rollouts.description: Rollout samples per finalist. Zero explicitly skips estimation.

top_k.description: Number of ranked finalists evaluated by rollout.

recurrence.description: Supplied together with `routine_instance_template`; `schedule_version` is set by the server.

routine_instance_template.description: Supplied together with `recurrence`; `template_version` is set by the server.

children.description: Task fields; blocked_by may name proposed siblings with one-based child:N references.

status.description: One of open, active, satisfied, abandoned. Objectives are withdrawn, never deleted.

FactProvenanceBody.description: How one value was established, and when. Nothing else.

oneOf.description: Store-built scope; ignored when a full request is supplied.

readiness.description: Computed response field; not a persisted task lifecycle status.

notice.description: Set when a routine template changed: materialized occurrences are unaffected.

display_probability.description: Rollout feasibility estimate. Null when probability_quality is not_estimated.

probability_interval_high.description: Upper bound of the rollout Wilson interval.

probability_interval_low.description: Lower bound of the rollout Wilson interval.

robustness_score.description: P10 rollout outcome used by the rollout-grounded composite.

end.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; must be after start.

start.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; converted to UTC Unix seconds.

PlanningReplayBody.description: Replay envelope only; never a scoring policy or planning input.

PlanningRequestBody.description:
Store-built coordinates and durations use Unix seconds; supplied requests
retain the caller's unit-agnostic kernel coordinates.

scoring_policy.description:
C-1 trade-off weights. Omitted policies use equal weights; the orchestrator
forwards the effective values and never learns or mutates them.

strict_validation.description: Reject rollout factorization failures instead of degrading with a diagnostic.

objective_a.description: Imported Objective pairs remain readable even though authoring rejects them.

ProvenanceKindBody.description:
`ubu-core`'s `ProvenanceKind`, spelled out so the document names its four
values. The two conversions below match on every variant, so a kind added to
`ubu-core` does not compile here until it is added to this too.

ReopenRequest.description: Undo of a completion, naming the completion it undoes.

completion_log_id.description: The `log_id` the completion returned. It must be the Task's latest completion.

log_id.description: The reopen decision that was recorded.

robustness_weight.description: Approximate pre-rollout robustness contribution weight. C-1 default: 1.0.

oneOf.description: Derived registry metadata, present only for effective provisional roots.

TaskPriorityBody.description: Request-local explanation only; never part of a persisted Plan.

duration.description: Legacy fixed duration used when `duration_estimate` is omitted.

container_id.description: Present only for a child of an active Container.

is_routine_occurrence.description: Occurrences are listed but rejected by `PATCH /task/{task_id}`.

unmeasured.description: Work that happened in the range and could not be measured.

TimeWindowBody.description: Unix seconds for store-built requests; caller-defined units for supplied requests.

oneOf.description:
How the value this mutation writes was established. Absent means
`asserted`. The two clears refuse it.

fact_provenance.description:
Keyed by full target, `<collection>.<key>`. A target with no entry has no
recorded provenance; an entry is removed with its value.

version.description:
The stored version, or null when the store holds no `UniverseState` and
this is the empty state preconditions are evaluated against.
